body.name: \(\mathsf{OCSI\text{-}ID}\)
body.construction: Compile \(\mathcal R\), construct the activation partition after substituting \(\mathbf x,\mathbf y\), enumerate the finite branch encodings prescribed by \(\mathsf H_{\mathrm{sat}}\), and return a verifier-accepted total expression when recovery closes; in the fixed-nuisance binary-sink slice it may instead return a verifier-accepted \(\Gamma_{\mathrm{sink}}\).
